statement: I study how work shapes people: the stress of knowledge work, the quality of working life, and what organisations can do better for the people in them.

about.lead: I'm an Assistant Professor in the Department of Business Administration at St. Joseph's College (Autonomous), Tiruchirappalli, a part-time Ph.D. scholar in Management Studies, and the founder of TOSS Charitable Trust.
story: I came to management from engineering. After a B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering at Karunya University, I worked as a studio technical coordinator at Kalai Kaviri College of Fine Arts, then took an M.B.A. in Human Resource Management and Marketing at M.A.M. College of Engineering and Technology. I qualified the Tamil Nadu State Eligibility Test in 2017 and the UGC National Eligibility Test in 2019, both in Management.

I have taught in higher education since 2016: first at MASTeR Group of Institutions, where I was also a human resource executive, then at Sri Meenakshi Vidiyal Arts and Science College, and since 2020 at St. Joseph's. My research looks at occupational stress and quality of work life in knowledge-intensive sectors, green human resource management in higher education, and what non-governmental organisations contribute to community literacy.

Alongside teaching, I have spent seventeen years with TOSS Charitable Trust, the youth-led organisation I founded in 2009. Its work with differently-abled children, readers and the environment is where much of my research begins.

teaching.title: Learning by doing
teaching.text: Management is a practice. My students plant trees with NGOs in government parks, volunteer at district sports meets for differently-abled children, and do their projects and internships with real organisations.

teaching.title: Digital-first classrooms
teaching.text: As departmental in-charge for JosTEL, the college's learning management system, I designed the programme's first fully digital component test and build e-content for self-paced courses.

teaching.title: AI, used well
teaching.text: I hold NPTEL certification in Artificial Intelligence in Human Resource Management and teach students to use AI tools and prompt engineering critically, as aids to thinking rather than replacements for it.

teaching.title: Tools I build
teaching.text: I wrote the Network Diagram Simulator, a free web app my Operations Research students use to draw project networks, find the critical path and test crashing.
